transcript.speaker: CEO John Smith
transcript.text: Good afternoon everyone. I'm pleased to announce another record quarter for Acme Corp.

transcript.speaker: CEO John Smith
transcript.text: Q4 revenue reached $39 million, up 34% year-over-year. This is our strongest quarter ever.

transcript.speaker: CFO Sarah Johnson
transcript.text: Gross margins expanded to 48%, driven by our enterprise segment growth.

transcript.speaker: CEO John Smith
transcript.text: Looking at full FY2024, we achieved $125 million in revenue, up 23% from FY2023.

transcript.speaker: CEO John Smith
transcript.text: Our Asia Pacific region continues to be the fastest growing, up 35% this year.

transcript.speaker: CFO Sarah Johnson
transcript.text: Operating cash flow was $28 million, giving us a strong balance sheet for growth investments.

transcript.speaker: CEO John Smith
transcript.text: For 2025, we're targeting $150 million revenue, a 20% increase.

transcript.speaker: CEO John Smith
transcript.text: Key initiatives include APAC expansion, AI analytics launch, and reaching 10,000 customers.
